english.title: Driver of hackney carriage / PHV failing to produce licence to constable for inspection - outside Greater London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the driver of

(A)_[a hackney carriage,]_
(B)_[a private hire vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), licensed by **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT COUNCIL..), failed without reasonable excuse to produce for inspection your driver's licence at the request of a constable

(C)_[forthwith]_
(D)_[before the expiration of the period of five days beginning with the day following that on which the request was made at a police station which is within the area of the council and was nominated by you when the request was made]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 53(4) and (5) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.

english.notes:
(i) See index relating to the subject of hackney carriages and private hire vehicles.
(ii) The time limits for production of this licence differs from the requirements of section 164 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 in relation to driving licences.
